text:
Maya Tran: FYI opened PR #523 to change how quota headers are surfaced in the API responses. This affects the tiered billing docs and the example panels in the dashboard docs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 :eyes:
Samir Patel: thanks — can you paste the new header names? I need to update the SDK snippet that shows how to read remaining quota for a user.
Maya Tran: sure — headers are now `X-RW-Quota-Limit`, `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`, and `X-RW-Quota-Reset-UTC`. Old `X-Quota-*` names are deprecated but will be supported for 30 days.
Samir Patel: perfect. I'll add a Python + JS example. Quick draft Python snippet:
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
limit = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Limit')
remaining = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Remaining')
reset = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Reset-UTC')
print(f"quota: {remaining}/{limit}, reset: {reset}")
```
Samir Patel: and JS: 
```js
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt })
const limit = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Limit')
const remaining = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Remaining')
const reset = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Reset-UTC')
console.log(`quota: ${remaining}/${limit}, reset: ${reset}`)
```
Zach Li: heads up — the Grafana panel in docs references metric `quota_used_total` but the actual metric we export is `rw_quota_consumed_total`. I updated the panel JSON in the draft but not sure which slug the docs page expects.
Maya Tran: thanks Zach — please push the panel JSON to the PR under `/assets/grafana/panels/quota_usage.json`. Also add a short caption: "Metric name: rw_quota_consumed_total" so readers don't copy the wrong name.
Zach Li: done and pushed. PR now includes the updated panel and a short note about metric rename.
Eli Reyes: I'll run a quick pass on the migration guide language — want to make sure we call out timing (30-day deprecation) and a small code diff to help engineers migrate. Also can add a tiny troubleshooting section: 'If headers are missing, check proxy passthrough and gateway config'.
Maya Tran: love that. Can you add the troubleshooting bullet under "Common migration issues" and include the proxy hint?
Eli Reyes: yup — will submit a follow-up commit in a few hours.
DocsBot: PR #523 status changed: reviews requested from @samir, @zach, @eli.
Samir Patel: requested changes pushed — switched examples to use `resp.headers.get` gracefully with fallback for old header names: `resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Remaining') or resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining')`.
Maya Tran: great. One last nit: in the pricing tiers page, the table cell for "Monthly quota" still lists only numeric token counts — can we add the header names in a footnote so product and infra teams can map dashboards to docs? e.g., "See headers: X-RW-Quota-*"
Zach Li: added footnote in the PR. Also updated the dashboard screenshot to show the panel title "Quota consumption (rw_quota_consumed_total)" — small visual fix.
Maya Tran: thanks everyone. After Eli's prose update and a quick spellcheck I'll merge. Targeting merge today EOD. :thumbsup:
Eli Reyes: prose update pushed, small wording tweaks. Leaving the final approve to Samir for SDK examples.
Samir Patel: approved. Merging once CI passes.
DocsBot: PR #523 merged by Maya Tran."
